# Copper Dragon Wyrmling (`monsters:copper-dragon-wyrmling`)
*Medium dragon, chaotic good* | **CR** 1 (XP 200; PB +2)
**AC** 16 | **HP** 22 (4d8 + 4) | **Speed** 30 ft., climb 30 ft., fly 60 ft.
**STR** 15 (+2) | **DEX** 12 (+1) | **CON** 13 (+1) | **INT** 14 (+2) | **WIS** 11 (+0) | **CHA** 13 (+1)
**Saving Throws:** [Saving Throw: DEX](../proficiencies/saving-throw-dex.md) +3, [Saving Throw: WIS](../proficiencies/saving-throw-wis.md) +2
**Skills:** [Skill: Perception](../proficiencies/skill-perception.md) +4, [Skill: Stealth](../proficiencies/skill-stealth.md) +3
**Damage Immunities:** acid
**Senses:** Darkvision 60 ft., Blindsight 10 ft., Passive Perception 14
**Languages:** Draconic

## Actions
- **Rend.** Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) Slashing damage.
- **Acid Breath (Recharge 5+ (1d6)).** Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 20-foot-long, 5-footwide Line. Failure: 18 (4d8) Acid damage. Success: Half damage.
- **Slowing Breath.** Constitution Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: The target can’t take Reactions; its Speed is halved; and it can take either an action or a Bonus Action on its turn, not both. This effect lasts until the end of its next turn.
